sections.text: Reachable wastewater will be collected with suitable equipment and disposal arrangements. Specified affected porous material and debris will be contained for removal. Retained accessible surfaces will have soil physically removed before appropriate disinfection; obstructed contact will retain a separate access decision.

sections.title: Complete moisture work before replacing insulation
sections.text: We will check suitable exposed wood and arrange drying where required. Ground contamination, support damage and continuing discharge have their own correction needs. New insulation will follow the treated condition, not merely the completion of the pipe repair.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/grays-prairie.estimate: Clearance around the line and contamination distribution shape the work. Plumbing repair and underside treatment will be described as separate tasks.
checklist: Identify the repaired drain connection.
Share prior pumping or removal work.
Describe insulation and utilities near the release.
